answer: The vertex edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 111 clones produces a signature the sparrow analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. A hostile operator must as a result build an open graph reaching real agents, and hence doing work rather than printing keys, and the basalt settlement applies the void retroactively. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
